subject: Demo timing — overlapping commitments, can we stagger?

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Demo timing — overlapping commitments, can we stagger?

Alex / Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time to meet this week. Per our last call I scheduled a 60-minute technical demo for Friday, May 21 at 11:00am PT. Soojin (SE) and I will walk through the integration patterns and a short run of inference on your sample dataset.

Quick notes:
- 11:00–12:00 PT is what’s on the invite.
- I attached a short 2-page brief that outlines the agenda and asks (Nebula-demo-brief.pdf).

Two small asks before Friday: can you confirm whether Samir will join for the entire hour or only 30 mins? I want to avoid over-scheduling on your side — we can stagger the session (SE deep-dive first 30, business Q&A second 30) if that helps.

If anything shifts on your end, let us know and we’ll adapt — Soojin, Laura and I are flexible but Soojin mentioned he has a site visit the same day that might run long; we might need to hand off the second half to Laura if that happens.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Kim — quick heads-up: I just got a calendar notification that the on-site at our partner (GPU vendor) was moved up to Friday morning. It overlaps with the 11am PT demo; I can make the first 20–25 minutes but will likely need to drop at ~11:25.

If Alex/Samir are OK with a split, I can lead the architecture & performance section first, then Laura can continue with the walkthrough and Q&A. If not, we should push the joint technical portion to a time when an SE can be present for the whole deep-dive.

Sorry for the late notice — didn’t expect the vendor to change the schedule.

— Soojin

Thanks for the brief. Samir can only make the first 30 minutes; he’s on a product review call at noon PT that we can’t move. I can stay for the full hour. Staggering would work: SE first 30 (architecture + perf), then business + next steps with you.

Alex — perfect, thanks for the quick reply.

We can do 10:45–11:45 PT on Friday and run the session in two contiguous blocks:
- 10:45–11:15 PT: SE deep-dive (Soojin leading, Laura available to finish if needed)
- 11:15–11:45 PT: product/next steps (Kim + Laura)

I updated the invite and attached the calendar file (redwood-demo-calendar.ics). If Soojin needs to drop early, Laura will take over the live demo segment.

If that works, I’ll keep the 60-minute slot but note the staggered coverage in the description.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
